title: Vegan Ironman: loading at 10-12 g/kg without animal food
message: Hi! Please make me a meal plan for next week, {Mon} to {Sun}. Sunday is my Ironman, I'm hoping to finish in around 11h30. The swim is in the sea.
Tuesday: 1h bike with 3 x 8 min at race effort
Thursday: 30 min swim with a few race-pace 200s
Saturday: 20 min easy ride and a 10 min jog to check the bike
I weigh 72 kg and live in the United Kingdom. I'm vegan. I've got 200 g cooked lentils and 2 ripe avocados to use up.
That's everything — please go ahead and make the plan.

judge.question: Taken as food for the whole race, does the race's `during` example add up to roughly its hourly carbohydrate range over the time the athlete expects to take? Count about 30–40 g for a 500 ml bottle of isotonic drink, 21–27 g for an energy gel, 43 g for an energy bar and 27 g for a banana.
